summary: Build credible carbon inventories, master GHG Protocol reporting, and create assurance-ready emissions outputs. Enroll in practical 5-day training.
lede: GHG Protocol training helps sustainability and emissions professionals build inventories and reporting packs. Participants learn to set organizational and operational boundaries, calculate Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions, screen Scope 3 categories, and document activity data and emission factors. Practical exercises include building calculation workbooks, checking data quality, and preparing reporting outputs for internal review.
audienceIntro: This carbon accounting and GHG Protocol reporting training is designed for professionals who need to build or improve emissions inventories, prepare reporting packs, and defend calculation methods across technical and business stakeholders.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of corporate operations, basic spreadsheets, and common sustainability or ESG reporting terms. No programming is required, but you should be comfortable working with Excel or a similar spreadsheet tool, reviewing utility and fuel data, and reading operational records such as invoices, metered usage, and procurement summaries. Prior exposure to carbon inventories, Scope 1, Scope 2, or Scope 3 concepts will help, but it is not mandatory. This course is delivered at an intermediate to advanced level, so advanced topics are taught at the operational and implementation level rather than as introductory theory.
